messages:
priya: Hey team — finalizing release notes for tomorrow's rollout. Quick checklist: canary runs at 10:00 UTC, quiet window 09:45–11:15 UTC, and announce to #general at 11:30. Link to draft: https://notion.so/rw-release-notes-draft (please comment inline).

deploybot: /deploy canary v2.14.0 --targets=canary-pool --timeout=30m
deploybot: Canary started: v2.14.0 -> canary-pool (10 hosts). Monitoring: latency, 5xx rate, error budget.

sam: @priya noted a small wording nit in the breaking changes section — "KV cache migration" reads as an action item. Suggest rephrase to "compatibility note" so customers don't think they need a manual migration.

priya: good catch, sam. I'll change it to "compatibility note" and add a short mitigation paragraph.

lisa: Heads up — we pinned runtime to `redwood-runtime@2026-02-3` in Dedicated. Confirm that note is in the draft (customers on dedicated capacity need to know pinning behavior).

priya: added a line under "Deployment details": "Dedicated customers: runtime pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-02-3; contact support for unpinning requests."

tia: Canary metrics snapshot (10m after start): p95 latency +6%, 5xx = 0.08% (baseline 0.03%), token throughput stable. Screenshot uploaded to the thread. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

leo: If 5xx is trending toward 0.2% we should trigger an automatic rollback. What's our soft threshold for this canary?

ops-oncall: our documented threshold is 0.15% 5xx sustained for 5m OR p95 latency degradation >25%. For manual rollback we usually require signoff from release owner + oncall.

priya: let's adopt ops-oncall's thresholds for this canary. I'll add a short "Rollback criteria" bullet in the release notes: 
- Auto-rollback: 5xx >= 0.15% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency +25% sustained for 5m.
- Manual rollback: release owner + oncall agree (post-mortem required if customer impact).

deploybot: Canary health update: 20m in — 5xx = 0.09%, p95 +8%. No automatic rollback triggered.

sam: Also adding a small blurb under "What changed" for model-serving: "Improved KV cache eviction to reduce memory churn during high-concurrency spikes." Keep it non-actionable.

lisa: One more ops note — will call out the pin in the console copy: "Pinned runtime for stability; we will schedule gradual unpin for customers on request."

priya: Thanks all. Final asks before I push the internal announce: anyone want to include an ops runbook link? It's at https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/release-rollback.

tia: put it in. Also add short checklist: who to ping in pagerduty and escalation steps.

ops-oncall: copied. I'll be on standby from 09:30–12:00 UTC. Pager: PD_Raw.

leo: small nit — can we change the internal announce subject line to "Staged rollout: v2.14.0 (canary -> general) — 10:00 UTC canary, 11:30 UTC announce" to reduce questions?

priya: done. I'll push the internal announce at 11:10 so ops has 20m heads-up before public announce.

deploybot: Canary finished: success. Promoting to general pool staged rollout in 10m.

priya: promoting now. Will post final internal announce at 11:10. Thanks everyone :pray:

leo: awesome — add a one-line "known issues" section with the small observed latency bump and the threshold we monitored, so folks are pre-primed.

priya: added. Publishing final internal announce (copy):
"Teams — heads up: staged rollout of v2.14.0 begins with a canary at 10:00 UTC. Canary completed successfully; promoting to general pool. Quiet window 09:45–11:15 UTC. Key notes: pinned runtime redwood-runtime@2026-02-3 for Dedicated customers; KV cache improvements; rollback criteria documented here: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/release-rollback. Oncall: ops-oncall (PD_Raw). Internal Q/A in #eng-releases. Public announce scheduled for 11:30 UTC."

ops-oncall: acknowledged. I'll watch the rollout and call for rollback if thresholds exceed.

sam: LGTM.

lisa: LGTM.

priya: sending internal announce now :rocket:

deploybot: /announce internal "Staged rollout v2.14.0 — canary complete, promoting to general" --channel=#eng-releases --when=6789012660

priya: thanks bot. Thread closed after promote.
